483:     } else if ft.is_symlink() {
484:         file_type = "symlink";
485:     } else {
486:         #[cfg(unix)]
487:         {
488:             if ft.is_block_device() {
489:                 file_type = "block device";
490:             } else if ft.is_char_device() {
491:                 file_type = "char device";
492:             } else if ft.is_fifo() {
493:                 file_type = "pipe";
494:             } else if ft.is_socket() {
495:                 file_type = "socket";
496:             }
497:         }
498:     }
499:     if use_mime_type {
500:         let display_path = Path::new(display_name);
501:         let normalized = expand_to_real_path(display_path);
502:         let original_extension = display_path
503:             .extension()
504:             .and_then(|ext| ext.to_str());
505:         let normalized_extension = normalized
506:             .extension()
507:             .and_then(|ext| ext.to_str());
508:         let mime_path = if original_extension == normalized_extension {
509:             normalized.as_path()
510:         } else {
511:             display_path
512:         };
513:         let file_name = mime_path
514:             .file_name()
515:             .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
516:             .unwrap_or(display_name);
517:         let parts: Vec<&str> = file_name.split('.').collect();
518:         let mut extensions: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
519:         let mut current_extension = String::new();
520:         for part in parts.iter().rev() {
521:             if current_extension.is_empty() {
522:                 current_extension.push_str(part);
523:             } else {
524:                 current_extension = format!("{}.{}", part, current_extension);
525:             }
526:             extensions.push(current_extension.clone());
527:         }
528:         if !extensions.is_empty() {
529:             extensions.pop();
530:             extensions.reverse();
531:         }
532:         let path_ext = mime_path
533:             .extension()
534:             .and_then(|ext| ext.to_str())
535:             .unwrap_or("");
536:         let mut resolved_ext = path_ext;
537:         if !path_ext.is_empty() {
538:             for ext in &extensions {
539:                 if ext == path_ext {
540:                     resolved_ext = ext.as_str();
541:                 }

544:         let mime_guess = if resolved_ext.is_empty() {
545:             "unknown".to_string()
